title: Question 19
passage:
Would you mind turning the fan down until I finish recording?
A. I can send you a copy of the recording. B. The fan was cleaned this morning. C. Sure. Tell me when I can turn it back up.
passageZh:
我錄完之前，可以麻煩你把風扇調小一點嗎？
A. 我可以傳一份錄製檔給你。 B. 風扇今天早上清過了。 C. 好啊。可以調回去時再跟我說。
